title: Convoy Route Manual
summary: Plan route, cargo, incidents, supplies, and exits before distance compounds mistakes.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Convoy play is about route discipline. You are not just moving from point A to point B; you are carrying risk, supplies, incidents, and recovery plans along the road.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Choose a destination, stage fuel or food, identify a fallback shelter, and mark the route before loading valuable cargo.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Scout, stage, travel, respond to incidents, unload, and update the route with what you learned. The best convoy path gets safer each time.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Route definitions and incident profiles describe what can happen on the way. Treat incidents as planning data, not surprise punishment.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: HoloMap marks routes, Logistics prepares cargo, WorldCore explains region risk, and Recovery softens the cost of a failed return.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If convoys keep failing, shorten the run, reduce cargo value, pre-place supplies, and solve the worst hazard before increasing distance.
